notes: Compliance-first gating: evaluated before economics. 'restricted' = Pass regardless of margin until resolved; 'approval' = Amazon category/product approval required.
Each required item has an id. Deals list the cert ids they already hold (certsHeld); everything else is a gap.
This is a decision-support checklist, not legal advice. verified=false entries need review by a compliance professional.

categories.label: Wireless earbuds / Bluetooth audio

required.label: FCC Part 15 (intentional radiator: FCC ID via TCB; supplier grant is acceptable if module is certified)

ipRisk: Generic stem/case designs → check Apple AirPods and Samsung design patents
checklist: Supplier test reports (FCC/UN38.3) dated within 12 months and matching your exact model
Submit Amazon hazmat (dangerous goods) review before creating the inbound shipment

categories.label: Power banks / lithium battery packs

required.label: UL 2056 / IEC 62133 safety test (Amazon requires for power banks)

checklist: Class 9 DG: air/express shipment requires DG-capable forwarder and surcharge
Watt-hour rating printed on the case

categories.label: Phone stands, cases, mounts (non-powered)
ipRisk: PopSockets utility patents on collapsible grips
checklist: Avoid brand-compatible phrasing that implies endorsement

categories.label: Kitchen tools / food-contact items

required.label: FDA 21 CFR food-contact material compliance (e.g., silicone 177.2600)

ipRisk: Viral gadget designs often have pending utility patents — search USPTO before ordering
checklist: LFGB/FDA test report from an accredited lab for each material
'BPA-free' claims need a supporting test

categories.label: Toys & children's products (12 and under)

required.label: ASTM F963 toy safety testing at a CPSC-accepted lab

checklist: Choking hazard warning for small parts (ages 3–6)
Amazon frequently requests CPC + test report post-listing — have them before launch

categories.label: Baby & infant products

required.label: Product registration card (durable infant products, 16 CFR 1130)

checklist: Check for product-specific mandatory standards (sleep, bath seats, carriers)

categories.label: Cosmetics & skincare

required.label: FDA cosmetic labeling (INCI ingredients, net qty, responsible person + adverse event contact)

checklist: Drug claims (acne, SPF, anti-aging 'repairs') make it an OTC drug — avoid or comply with OTC monograph
Amazon requires expiration dates for many topicals

categories.label: Dietary supplements
checklist: Importing finished supplements requires FDA prior notice per shipment
No disease claims

categories.label: Apparel & textiles

required.label: FTC Textile Act label (fiber content, origin, RN/identity)

checklist: Children's sleepwear has separate flammability standards (16 CFR 1615/1616)
Cotton from Xinjiang → UFLPA detention risk; keep supply-chain tracing

categories.label: Fitness accessories (mats, bands, rollers)
checklist: Latex products need allergy warning
Weight claims must match measured product

categories.label: Home organization & storage
ipRisk: Distinctive designs from Joseph Joseph/OXO → design patent check
checklist: Metal content may trigger Section 232 derivative duties

categories.label: LED lighting & strip lights (mains/USB powered)

required.label: UL/ETL listing for mains-powered adapters (strongly recommended; Amazon may require)

checklist: Power adapter must be certified; cheapest adapters are the #1 recall cause

categories.label: Pet accessories (non-food)
checklist: Pet food/treats are FDA-regulated — out of scope for this category

categories.label: Automotive parts & accessories
ipRisk: OEM trademarks in titles → use 'compatible with' carefully
checklist: Bad fitment = high return rates; budget returns at 10%+

categories.label: Fashion jewelry

required.label: Lead/cadmium testing (mandatory for children's jewelry; state laws for adult)

ipRisk: Designer look-alikes (Cartier/Van Cleef motifs) → trademark/trade dress
checklist: 'Sterling', '14k' claims require stamping + assay evidence

categories.label: Sunglasses & eyewear

required.label: UV400/ANSI Z80.3 test report backing UV claims

checklist: FDA registration of the importer for eyewear (medical device class I)
